system.description:
STANCE

You have learned to centre your body and spirit together, allowing the guidance of unseen ancestors and nearby spirits to sharpen your reactions.

You enter Spirit Stance.

While in Spirit Stance, you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to AB and DB against spirits, incorporeal creatures and creatures possessing another creature.

Furthermore, your physical Strikes are treated as magical for the purpose of overcoming the defences of incorporeal creatures and spirits.

Use: enters the stance at the core's default of 1 AP (the per-round Stance rule, the previous stance's replacement and Stance Mastery all as the core's own stances). While it lasts: +1 circumstance to your attack checks and to your DB against creatures with the Spirit or Incorporeal trait, and your physical Strikes count as magical against them; a creature possessing another is offered as a tick on your attacks. Delete the stance's effect to leave it.
